debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting. Set to true only when diagnosing issues.

state_dir.description: Directory where Receptor stores persistent node state, completed work results, and metadata.

work_dir.description: Directory for temporary files and transient worker data.

tls.description: TLS/SSL certificate and key configuration for secure mesh communication.

cert_file.description: Path to the node’s public certificate (PEM format).

key_file.description: Path to the node’s private key (PEM format).

ca_file.description: Path to the trusted CA certificate for verifying peers.

listener.description: Network listener configuration for incoming peer connections.

listen_addr.description: Local address and port for Receptor to listen on (e.g., '127.0.0.1:8080' or ':8080').

advertise_addr.description: Public address Receptor advertises to peers (useful behind NAT/firewalls).

max_conns.description: Maximum number of concurrent inbound connections allowed.

result_ttl.description: Time-to-live (seconds) for work results stored in the state directory.

nodes.description: List of mesh nodes (other Receptor instances). At least one peer is required for a functional mesh.

items.description: A single peer node in the mesh.

name.description: Unique name for this node (must be unique in the mesh).

address.description: Host and port of the peer node (e.g., '192.168.1.10:8080').

role.description: Node role (e.g., 'worker', 'controller'). Usually 'worker' for compute nodes.

cert_name.description: Certificate subject name used to verify this peer (optional).

workers.description: List of workers (named job executors) that accept work from the mesh.

name.description: Unique name of the worker (used in job submissions).

command.description: Command or script to execute (required for 'exec' type).

work_dir.description: Working directory for the worker process.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the worker process (key=value).

max_jobs.description: Maximum number of concurrent jobs this worker can process.

services.description: List of services (long-running TCP/HTTP proxies or executables) managed by Receptor.

command.description: Command to run as a service (for 'exec' type).

acls.description: Access control lists to restrict peer access or command execution.

allow_peers.description: List of peer names allowed to use this ACL (or ['*'] for all).

allow_commands.description: List of worker commands allowed under this ACL.

deny_peers.description: List of peers explicitly denied (overrides allow).

deny_commands.description: List of commands explicitly denied (overrides allow).

level.description: Minimum log level (debug, info, warn, error).

file.description: Path to log file. Empty or absent sends logs to stderr.
